question: Can a cutoff-bounded SW2021 L1 basket rebuild reproduce R05 and append October without rewriting September?
scope: All existing L1 assignments and verified normalized stock partitions; existing local sources only. No labels, fitting or acquisition. L2/L3 update not implemented in this round.
rules: Preserve R05 prior-month membership, unresolved denominator, 80% coverage, minimum five members, float32 stock relative returns, chain/conflict rules, anchor and gap blocks. Use only stock/calendar rows <= cutoff and assignments from months strictly before cutoff month.
comparison: All DAILY columns and keys vs R05 prefix; R102 regenerated features vs existing R102 outputs, 1e-12 tolerance. Any differences are failures, not tuned away.
append: Identity-key merge accepts exact duplicate rows; rejects changed historical rows and unseen rows on/before previous max date. New source revisions require a separate full version.
boundaries: Historical-proxy and local replay; no new market data, no first-vintage certification, no deployment or model adoption. Full-prefix rebuild is not efficient incremental computation.
